s1.description: Problem statement: every stuck rupee starts a regulatory timer that nobody is watching.

s2.description: Proposed solution: an agent that attaches a clock to every stuck rupee and drives it to zero.

s3.description: Technology and tech stack: five layers, with everything that moves money kept deterministic.

s4.description: USP: every other agent ends in a sentence, ours ends in a credit.

s5.description: Impact and benefits, and the ablation we measure them against.

s6.description: Business model: a closed clock is the first honestly billable unit in support.
